verdict.rationale: A hosted agent service could plausibly offer a versioned API, so this axis applies to Grok Bot. The runtime probe found no public Grok Bot API: the OpenAPI spec at docs.x.ai covers xAI's separate model REST API and contains zero grok-bot paths, and no Grok Bot docs page mentions API versioning or a deprecation policy. That model-API spec belongs to a different product and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
